## Experience

- **LOCOMeX, Inc**, Software Engineer Intern (Feb 2025 to Jan 2026): ESG scoring platform in Django with async PDF extraction and LLM processing (Claude 3 Haiku and LLaMA 3.2 1B via AWS Bedrock), cutting response time by 35%; PDF/CSV report exports and automated delivery via AWS SES.
